item.title: Countries warn against travel to Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks
item.description: US, Australia, Canada, Japan, South Korea and New Zealand among countries urging citizens to avoid travel to the kingdom.

item.title: Clashes reported in Yemen as Houthis advance towards Taiz
item.description: Heavy clashes have been reported between Houthi fighters and Yemeni- forces near the strategic southern city of Taiz.

item.title: China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties
item.description: Chinese Foreign Ministry cites national sovereignty and Taiwan separatist activities as reasons behind the measures.

item.title: Netanyahu demands probe into sources for award-winning Gaza film NAZA
item.description: Documentary draws on 24 anonymous Israeli sources accusing military of killing Palestinians in Gaza using AI systems.

item.title: Ethiopian troops enter Adigrat in Tigray, near the Eritrean border
item.description: Ethiopian government forces entered Adigrat in northern Tigray after rebel fighters withdrew.

item.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles towards the sea
item.description: Latest missile launch appears to be a show of force since South Korea's hypersonic missile test-fire, Seoul says.

item.title: At least 139 dead as migrant boat from Djibouti to Yemen capsizes
item.description: At least 139 migrants, including 15 children, have died and 84 remain missing after a migrant boat capsized.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says 1 dead, 11 injured in latest attack on Riyadh airport
item.description: Sunday's strike on King Khalid International airport kills a Pakistani national.

item.title: Bridge washed away by torrent of water in Nepal
item.description: Flash floods along Nepal’s Budhi Gandaki River swept away homes and bridges, forcing residents to flee to higher ground.

item.title: UK PM Andy Burnham says it is ‘clear’ Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit vote
item.description: Claim marks the first time a UK prime minister has publicly acknowledged Russia's interference in the vote to leave EU.

item.title: Iran’s FM urges diplomacy in call with Saudi counterpart
item.description: Tehran offers to facilitate talks between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis following deadly strikes on the kingdom.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias leaves trail of destruction across the US Gulf Coast
item.description: Crews rally for massive cleanup effort in Florida and Alabama as Isaias leaves hundreds of thousands in the dark.

item.title: Ceuta or Sebta? Why one city has two names and a disputed status
item.description: Felipe VI’s first visit to Ceuta and Melilla as king brings Spain’s territorial dispute with Morocco back into focus.

item.title: Iran war live: Riyadh airport hit again; Tehran says US reply ‘inadequate’
item.description: Iran says US has accepted some of its peace terms but calls the reply 'inadequate', as Riyadh airport is hit again.

item.title: Pakistani national killed in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
item.description: Saudi authorities say a Pakistani national was killed and several people injured in a second strike on Riyadh’s Airport.

item.title: US Homeland Security secretary sees no ‘risk’ from livestreamed execution
item.description: Decision to livestream Nidal Hasan execution has led to harsh criticism and warnings that it could encourage violence.

item.title: Footage shows moment Russian strike hits Ukrainian grocery store
item.description: CCTV footage shows the moment of a Russian strike on a residential street in Kharkiv, Ukraine.

item.title: CCTV shows moment of deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
item.description: CCTV footage released by Al Arabiya shows the moment of a Houthi strike on Riyadh’s international airport on Saturday.

item.title: At least 72 Sudanese miners killed in air strike: Rights monitor
item.description: Emergency Lawyers blames Egypt for the deadly attack in northern Sudan.

item.title: Waves crash into homes as excavators try to protect California properties
item.description: Construction crews were seen trying to block waves entering homes along California's coast

item.title: UK Greens leader seeks rule change after party declares Zionism is racism
item.description: Zack Polanski calls for internal rule reforms to give party leaders greater control over policy after Zionism vote.

item.title: Two killed near Israeli-occupied area in south Lebanon
item.description: Despite ceasefire reached between Israel and Lebanon in June, Israeli attacks continue.

item.title: Deadly air strike kills dozens at Sudan gold mine near Egypt border
item.description: An air strike hit a gold mine near Sudan’s border with Egypt, killing at least 72 people and injuring more than 50.

item.title: How Man City beat Liverpool after guilty verdict
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Rahul Pathak was at Anfield, where fans reminded City of their guilty verdict after the match.

item.title: Zelenskyy welcomes US-announced energy ceasefire
item.description: President Zelenskyy has responded to Donald Trump’s announcement that Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire
